messages.author: 7417bd10b82992b3
messages.subject: frailty survival model
parts:
Hello, everyone

I'm want to built a frailty survival model using INLA.
I havent found useful material yet on this topic in the website  in the FAQ section and so I am wondering if someone can share any related material with me.

I would appreciate some tutorials or case studies with model examples including the thoery aspect with  the concepts application in the codes to make things clearer. I am using cross sectional data with a right censored survival object.

I would really appreciate any help. 

Kind regards

Bester

messages.author: 953deaf1a512b96e
messages.subject: Re: frailty survival model
parts:
Hi,
You can fit frailty survival models using INLA through the INLAjoint package (https://github.com/DenisRustand/INLAjoint). The vignette includes an example (Model 11), you can find it here:
https://github.com/DenisRustand/INLAjoint/blob/main/vignettes/INLAjoint.pdf

Also in this preprint: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2212.01900.pdf, there is another example in Section 8.

Please let me know if you have any questions.
Best,
Denis Rustand
he...@r-inla.org

messages.subject: Re: frailty survival model

Also this book gives you an example using directly INLA (chapter 10.6): https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/ch-survival.html#frailty-models

It's a nice book to get introduced to the theory and applications of INLA.
